# Overview

## Trainers and Facilitators 

For workshop delivered August/September 2026

* Nicholas Matigan, QCIF
* Sarah Williams, QCIF 

## Code of conduct

In order to foster a positive and professional learning environment we encourage the following kinds of behaviours at all our events and on our platforms:

- Use welcoming and inclusive language
- Be respectful of different viewpoints and experiences
- Gracefully accept constructive criticism
- Focus on what is best for the community
- Show courtesy and respect towards other community members
- Our full code of conduct, with incident reporting guidelines, is available
[here](https://zenodo.org/records/4276854).

## Course survey

Please fill out our course survey at the end of the workshop. Help us help you!
